events.title: ZERO TO THREE LEARN Conference 2026
events.why: Multi-day early childhood conference in Hall A, overlapping other shows at the convention center through Oct. 29.

events.title: Bryson Tiller The Neo Trapsoul Tour
events.why: Thursday night arena concert at the Coliseum, so expect Rose Quarter traffic and busy MAX trains.

events.title: Gorillaz with Little Simz and Deltron 3030
events.why: Arena show on The Mountain Tour on a Friday night, so expect Rose Quarter traffic and busy MAX trains.

events.title: CANVAS 2026
events.why: Six-day conference filling three convention center halls, keeping the Lloyd District busy into early November.

events.title: The Smashing Pumpkins: Rats in a Cage tour
events.why: Arena show marking 30 years of Mellon Collie and the Infinite Sadness, with the album played as the first set.

events.title: Portland Book Festival
events.venue: South Park Blocks and Portland Art Museum, Downtown
events.why: The festival's big day packs the South Park Blocks with author talks and book sellers, capping a week of citywide Portland Book Week events from Nov. 2 to 8.

events.title: Oddities & Curiosities Expo
events.why: A large traveling oddities market filling three convention halls from 10 a.m. to 5 p.m. both days, the same weekend as a martial arts festival in Hall A.

events.title: Teddy Swims: The UGLY Tour
events.why: Sunday 7 p.m. arena show on Teddy Swims' North American tour, so expect evening Rose Quarter traffic and crowded MAX trains.

events.title: Kumoricon 2026
events.why: Oregon's biggest anime convention takes over every exhibit hall at the convention center for three days, with heavy crowds around the Lloyd District and MAX.

events.title: OSAA 6A and 5A soccer state finals
events.why: The boys and girls 6A and 5A title games are scheduled at Hillsboro Stadium, with the smaller-school finals at nearby Liberty High; kickoff times are set once the brackets finish.

events.title: Oregon vs. Oregon State men's basketball
events.why: The Civil War rivalry comes to Portland for the first neutral-site regular-season meeting since 1996, a 6 p.m. Thursday tip on Big Ten Network.

events.title: ZooLights at the Oregon Zoo
events.why: Nightly from 4:30 p.m. (closed Nov. 24 to 26 and Dec. 25) with dated tickets sold in advance; it fills the Washington Park lots and the Highway 26 exit on weekends.

events.title: Major League Table Tennis
events.why: Pro table tennis matches in Hall A of the convention center the weekend before Thanksgiving.

events.title: OSAA football state championships (6A, 5A and 2A)
events.why: The OSAA lists Hillsboro Stadium as host for the 6A, 5A and 2A title games; its calendar puts the finals on Nov. 27 and 28, while the 6A bracket page runs through Nov. 26, so check the bracket for each game's day and time.

events.title: Pioneer Courthouse Square Tree Lighting
events.why: The 42nd annual lighting of the 75-foot tree, 5:30 to 6:45 p.m. the day after Thanksgiving, packs downtown and slows buses and MAX around the square.

events.title: Ramon Ayala Historia De Un Final
events.why: Coliseum concert by the norteño star the day after Thanksgiving, the same evening as the Pioneer Courthouse Square tree lighting.

events.title: Trans-Siberian Orchestra: The Ghosts of Christmas Eve
events.why: Two shows (3:30 and 8 p.m.) on the 30th anniversary tour the Saturday after Thanksgiving, so the Rose Quarter is busy most of the day.

events.title: USA Track and Field Annual Meeting
events.why: Week-long USATF annual meeting in the convention center's Oregon Ballroom, bringing national track and field delegates to the Lloyd District.

events.title: Christmas Ships Parade
events.why: Lit boat fleets sail different stretches of both rivers on most evenings, drawing crowds to riverfront parks and restaurants; the route changes nightly, so check the schedule.

events.title: Triumph with April Wine: The Rock & Roll Machine Reloaded Tour
events.why: Saturday 8 p.m. arena show on the Canadian rockers' 50th anniversary tour, so expect evening Rose Quarter traffic and busy MAX trains.

events.title: The Wolf's Nice Christmas Show
events.why: Sunday 7 p.m. country radio holiday show with Max McNown, Ian Munsick, Graham Barham and Blake Whiten, the night after the Triumph show next door, so the Rose Quarter is busy two nights running.

events.title: Ram PBR Portland
events.why: Two nights of Professional Bull Riders at the Moda Center in late January.
